problem_or_genesis_goal: The selected project folder is forgotten when the app restarts, so the next session cannot continue in the same workspace.
reproduction_evidence: electron/main.ts keeps projectRoot in a process-local variable. feature-inventory FEAT-002 is PARTIAL for that reason.
user_impact: A developer who reopens Open-Ro has to choose the folder again before file tools work.
indivisibility_proof: The persisted field, the main-process read/write, and the unit test are one behavior.
non_goals: Do not launch Electron in this iteration

acceptance_oracles.description: A saved root round-trips through parse and is ignored when the path is empty.

metamorphic_invariants: Saving a root and parsing the same JSON returns that root
A missing root stays empty rather than becoming the process cwd
